ticker: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy scandal
Microsoft hit by major global Outlook and Teams outage
Indian markets open lower on oil surge and inflation
US freezes $2.7 billion following North Korea Binance hack
Trump issues strong warning to Iran amid rising tensions

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy Scandal
articles.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following controversies surrounding an alleged relationship with a woman suspected of Chinese espionage, sending shockwaves through the tech sector and drawing sharp reactions from US lawmakers and President Trump.

articles.headline: Microsoft Outage Disrupts Global Business and Government Systems
articles.brief: A major Microsoft outage has dragged on for hours, severely disrupting Outlook and Teams for numerous businesses and government agencies worldwide as the tech giant struggles to apply server fixes.

articles.headline: Indian Shares Open Lower Amid Oil Surge and Inflation
articles.brief: Indian equity markets opened lower following a three-day rally, weighed down by rising global crude oil prices, ongoing inflation jitters, and broader economic concerns across Asian markets.

articles.headline: US Details $2.7 Billion Freeze After North Korea Binance Hack
articles.brief: The US Justice Department has announced a major asset freeze involving stablecoin issuers to secure nearly half of the funds stolen during a massive $6 billion cyber heist on the Binance cryptocurrency exchange linked to North Korean hackers.

articles.headline: US Democrats Probe Nvidia China Chip Sales Deal
articles.brief: US lawmakers and congressional Democrats have launched an official investigation into a controversial Trump administration agreement allowing Nvidia to export advanced AI chips to China in exchange for a percentage of sales revenue.

articles.headline: Kalshi Ends Donald Trump Jr Advisory Contract Over Polymarket
articles.brief: Prediction market platform Kalshi has officially terminated Donald Trump Jr's advisory contract, citing potential conflicts of interest related to competing platform Polymarket.

articles.headline: Murdoch and Shankar Firm Acquires South Indian Food Chain
articles.brief: A joint investment firm backed by Murdoch and Shankar has agreed to acquire a majority stake in a prominent south Indian restaurant food chain for $180 million.

articles.headline: Prime Minister Modi to Attend ASEAN Summit in Manila
articles.brief: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to travel to Manila to participate in the upcoming ASEAN summit, engaging regional leaders on trade, security, and diplomatic partnerships.

articles.headline: Harry Kane Scores on Record-Breaking Night for England
articles.brief: England captain Harry Kane netted another crucial goal during a historic performance in the UEFA Nations League, while Italy secured a notable victory against France in group stage action.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Severe Levels Near 500 AQI
articles.brief: Delhi's air quality index approached severe levels near 500 on Friday morning, accompanied by dense fog and drastically reduced visibility, prompting health warnings across the entire National Capital Region.

articles.headline: Oil Tanker Struck Off UAE Coast With Crew Safe
articles.brief: An oil tanker off the coast of the United Arab Emirates near Ras Al-Khaimah was reportedly struck by an unknown projectile, though all crew members were safely accounted for without serious injury.

articles.headline: Iran Revolutionary Guards Target US Radar Station in Bahrain
articles.brief: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed responsibility for targeting a US military early-warning radar installation situated in Bahrain amid escalating regional military tensions.
